name: DISMANTLING DOUBTS Workshop
description:
DISMANTLING DOUBTS

A two-day journey from doubt to certainty.

Your doubts deserve more than slogans. They deserve answers.

Doubt has arguments. So does truth.

Join us for Dismantling Doubts, a two-part workshop series exploring two of the most fundamental questions every Muslim should be able to answer:

Why believe in Allah?
Why believe in Muhammad ﷺ?

Across two Sundays, we’ll critically examine the evidence, arguments, and ideas that every Muslim should understand—not only to strengthen their own conviction, but to confidently engage with the questions and challenges of our time.



🔑 Day 1 — Dismantling Atheism, Discovering True Freedom

📅 Sunday, 2 August 2026

Is atheism really the rational default?

Does religion limit freedom—or is true freedom found in submission to Allah?

This workshop takes an evidence-based look at atheism’s strongest claims, the assumptions that underpin them, and the questions they struggle to answer.

Leave with greater clarity, stronger conviction, and practical tools to respond confidently when your faith is challenged.



✨ Day 2 — Establishing the Prophethood of Muhammad ﷺ

📅 Sunday, 16 August 2026

Why Muhammad ﷺ?

Character. Miracles. History. Prophecy.

Explore the compelling evidence for the Prophethood of the Final Messenger ﷺ and discover how the historical, rational, and prophetic proofs come together to establish the truth of his message.

Develop the confidence to present the case for Islam with wisdom, clarity, and conviction.



🎟️ Tickets

name: ISR Heritage Dinner
description:
🌍 ISR HERITAGE DINNER 🌍

A night where cultures come together, stories are shared, and our community gathers around one table 🫂🍽️

Join us for the ISR Heritage Dinner, an evening celebrating the rich cultures, traditions, clothing, flavours, and experiences that make up our diverse Muslim community 🙂‍↕️

Come dressed in your cultural attire, bring your friends, and enjoy a night filled with delicious food, meaningful connection, entertainment, and memories with people from across the world. Whether you are reconnecting with your roots or learning about someone else’s, this is a celebration for everyone.

📅 Date: Monday 24th of August
🕕 Time: 3.30 PM - 8 PM
📍 Location: RMIT Building 16, Storey Hall
